signals.summary: Low-effort, high-reward gardening — 'chaos gardening' with scattered seed, native wildflower meadows, roses in meadow plantings and 'grandma gardens' — as the season's dominant, highly photogenic garden trend.
signals.why_now: The Times 'The latest gardening trend? Roses in wildflower meadows' (270h), The Cool Down on the 'lemonading' garden trend (246h), plus a deep run of chaos-gardening features (Axios, Hartford Courant, NYT, Realtor.com). Seasonal for high summer and among the most producible subjects in the whole taxonomy — flowers, beds, meadows.

signals.topic: National Park Week & serene scenic hikes
signals.summary: The Senate's Aug 22-30 National Park Week designation coinciding with a wave of 'quietest place', alpine-lake and serene-waterfall hike features — calm, saveable park landscapes.
signals.why_now: Legis1 'Senate Designates August 22-30 as National Park Week' (12h), Islands 'One Of Sierra Nevada's Most Scenic Hikes... Chain Of Crystal-Clear Alpine Lakes' (12h) and Travel + Leisure 'This National Park Is the Quietest Place on Earth' (45h). Time-bound and highly producible as landscape stills.

signals.summary: 'Gorpcore' — technical hiking gear reframed as fashion — with barely-there hiking sandals and design-forward trail brands crossing from the trail into style pages.
signals.why_now: E! News 'Gorpcore Is the Cool-Girl Trend Making Hiking Gear Stylish' (96h), Harper's Bazaar 'This Fashion-Adjacent Hiking Brand Looks Just as Good as It Feels' (88h) and Vogue 'The Barely-There Hiking Sandal Is the Official Shoe of the Summer'. Strong and cross-outlet, but producibility is only moderate — the imagery leans on worn apparel and bodies.
